description: Held-out wording frozen after defining prototype-class gating and before observing its outputs.

cf_distance_low.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; positional convergence toward the designated location need not drive the maneuver.

cf_distance_mid.description: Preserve an even allocation of concern across flight progress, endurance, hazards, and assignments.

cf_distance_high.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; shorten the straight-line displacement to the designated location whenever feasible.

cf_energy_low.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; stored electrical power may be expended liberally during the maneuver.

cf_energy_mid.description: Preserve an even allocation of concern across flight progress, endurance, hazards, and assignments.

cf_energy_high.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; minimize propulsion demand and retain electrical reserve capacity.

cf_collision_low.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; separation conflicts and limited contact exposure can be accepted.

cf_collision_mid.description: Preserve an even allocation of concern across flight progress, endurance, hazards, and assignments.

cf_collision_high.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; deconflict the paths so vehicle bodies never touch.

cf_safety_low.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; a tight formation with small clearance is acceptable.

cf_safety_mid.description: Preserve an even allocation of concern across flight progress, endurance, hazards, and assignments.

cf_safety_high.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; spread the team and sustain large protective clearance between members.

cf_task_low.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; some allocated work may remain unresolved at shutdown.

cf_task_mid.description: Preserve an even allocation of concern across flight progress, endurance, hazards, and assignments.

cf_task_high.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; service every allocated destination and leave no work unresolved.

cf_time_low.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; a leisurely response with deferred arrival is permissible.

cf_time_mid.description: Preserve an even allocation of concern across flight progress, endurance, hazards, and assignments.

cf_time_high.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; react promptly and eliminate avoidable arrival latency.

cf_threat_low.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; crossing detected or surveilled airspace is permissible.

cf_threat_mid.description: Preserve an even allocation of concern across flight progress, endurance, hazards, and assignments.

cf_threat_high.description: Keep all other tradeoffs fixed; stay clear of surveillance coverage and hostile hazard regions.
